questions.q: Which student activist became the first SFI member to be elected sarpanch in Gujarat in June 2025?
questions.explain: In June 2025, student activist Satyesha Leuva made history by becoming the first member of the Students' Federation of India (SFI) to be elected as a sarpanch in Gujarat.
